correctness.rationale: An explicit polynomial map on R^4 has a period-four orbit whose Jacobian cocycle has simple top Lyapunov exponent a>b>0, yet h_{2k}=a and h_{2k+1}=(a+b)/2 exactly. The matrix telescoping, spectral-radius parity formula, singular-value growth, and residue-class transversality calculation are analytic; the compact verification artifact reproduces the identities numerically.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge and restricted to the source-specific correction. General failure of spectral-radius convergence is prior work, including Aoun-Sert and the literature summarized by Martinez Ramos. No located public correction to arXiv:2609.18017v1 gives this smooth deterministic counterexample or the endpoint-transversality/frame-dependence diagnosis.

value.rationale: The source uses h_L as an interpolation toward Lyapunov growth and invokes the Lyapunov gap as the alignment scale. The counterexample shows that this implication does not follow from a non-degenerate top exponent, while also identifying a concrete condition that restores convergence on periodic residue classes and preserving the distinction between the source's empirical finite-L observations and the invalid general theorem claim.
